# Aurelix

> Aurelix is an AI-native creator universe for realtime interaction, premium creator monetization, live streaming, and intelligent digital culture.

Aurelix combines a social feed, short-form reels, live streams, creator subscriptions, and an AI assistant into one platform.

## Pages

- [Feed](/): Personalized feed of posts, creators, and community moments.
- [Reels](/reels): Short-form vertical video from creators across Aurelix.
- [Discover](/discover): Explore trending creators, tags, and communities.
- [Live](/live): Live streams and paid live events from creators.
- [Premium](/premium): Aura Pro membership — subscribe for exclusive creator content.
- [Store](/store): Aurelix store — creator products and digital goods.
- [Hall of Founders](/hall-of-founders): Featured founders shaping the Aurelix ecosystem.
- [News](/news): Latest updates, announcements, and creator news.
- [Support](/support): Help center — contact support, report content, verification.

## Optional

- [Sign in](/auth): Sign in or create an Aurelix account.
